Hangover fatigue is ` [Highlight start] next-day exhaustion and sluggishness caused by alcohol's disruption of your sleep, hydration, blood sugar, and inflammatory response [Highlight end] ` . Symptoms typically start 6 to 8 hours after drinking—as blood alcohol drops—and usually ease within 8 to 24 hours as your body recovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1xmBQWLPtUTSQ3zVx6cvRaP-fVT9VjZ3Q22oOxDEFxAYVayW1mCIkG5ZJrCDP3eloJ4q2mLrJJxdY8o23XkC_K7z891NF35II-PyjnnJZ2Yu2I5hk6bAbvGn26614yOdvOZhjtYiiP3SGIVyNde0bsqs7DaiJpNSzvIDINWk3QEI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXMm9lMG5PWjXCFo-ZGGIVqtOV-oFDtTETNQj8kiFg9Bk_SkD0gVu1MwgsceXMfi6kITlEak_spPdudLG3CSSelzBvv5jdnJgGarzvI95MehVxBp78U_OxIW2JLb0sGOIUeg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXOG4lZKwn7B4x3K0DqVaZ0flp15cNCRDD5Cmh2ZTAUDVhGoGSc2L1ZhdpuwiJho9zee8meGxfF_cFIM014HoE_B4fbHiyfk7pvnuwWYH_H-UCtu27X7unoVP4BR_y90ea)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXJmqMdj3V3f03soPUR0Hz0h1jjI2cpIFIqqJUolf0KgokCLVQBLznKCZRSFUyWhMiq8aTDfCUiRbvQyLdd0lZSvFe3rjRCHNdC3UuWWdOOLJMTcPyDhze_qSjc2dXsC1TY4BhPogxOr9adR4ocBaGk7_N6g)

### Why Hangover Fatigue Happens

- **Disrupted sleep:** Alcohol may help you fall asleep faster, but it fragments sleep later in the night and reduces restorative sleep.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1xmBQWLPtUTSQ3zVx6cvRaP-fVT9VjZ3Q22oOxDEFxAYVayW1mCIkG5ZJrCDP3eloJ4q2mLrJJxdY8o23XkC_K7z891NF35II-PyjnnJZ2Yu2I5hk6bAbvGn26614yOdvOZhjtYiiP3SGIVyNde0bsqs7DaiJpNSzvIDINWk3QEI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXMm9lMG5PWjXCFo-ZGGIVqtOV-oFDtTETNQj8kiFg9Bk_SkD0gVu1MwgsceXMfi6kITlEak_spPdudLG3CSSelzBvv5jdnJgGarzvI95MehVxBp78U_OxIW2JLb0sGOIUeg)
- **Mild dehydration:** Alcohol suppresses vasopressin (antidiuretic hormone), increasing urination and fluid loss.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1xmBQWLPtUTSQ3zVx6cvRaP-fVT9VjZ3Q22oOxDEFxAYVayW1mCIkG5ZJrCDP3eloJ4q2mLrJJxdY8o23XkC_K7z891NF35II-PyjnnJZ2Yu2I5hk6bAbvGn26614yOdvOZhjtYiiP3SGIVyNde0bsqs7DaiJpNSzvIDINWk3QEI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXOG4lZKwn7B4x3K0DqVaZ0flp15cNCRDD5Cmh2ZTAUDVhGoGSc2L1ZhdpuwiJho9zee8meGxfF_cFIM014HoE_B4fbHiyfk7pvnuwWYH_H-UCtu27X7unoVP4BR_y90ea)
- **Inflammation:** Alcohol metabolism triggers inflammatory chemicals (like cytokines) that cause whole-body sluggishness and malaise.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1xmBQWLPtUTSQ3zVx6cvRaP-fVT9VjZ3Q22oOxDEFxAYVayW1mCIkG5ZJrCDP3eloJ4q2mLrJJxdY8o23XkC_K7z891NF35II-PyjnnJZ2Yu2I5hk6bAbvGn26614yOdvOZhjtYiiP3SGIVyNde0bsqs7DaiJpNSzvIDINWk3QEI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXgAwvc3BjHoF_Y4bOI2XOg4sYqWswKifPXhRSz4_6gzrlQfgHoSKquzvntye2CnORkr05r4rqMY8b5Ab2VuuVHWn2B3Iwvx3JYdoJNoa8E_Hc7Qlr46WuXoNqiPIoLFtgyuberEYt)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXB7mINvuoN4ZEbUry19AspberT19ixK0rc9_dqcNwcYfJcr1S5CE2J0efvfb6CcolqGAh3tNd9XRweh9mIW2unrTg9Slz1H0YzoUxQjZGKBWs93X6vENHyrnQDsV2gjaE)
- **Blood sugar swings:** Alcohol interferes with glucose regulation, which can leave you feeling weak or drained.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXMm9lMG5PWjXCFo-ZGGIVqtOV-oFDtTETNQj8kiFg9Bk_SkD0gVu1MwgsceXMfi6kITlEak_spPdudLG3CSSelzBvv5jdnJgGarzvI95MehVxBp78U_OxIW2JLb0sGOIUeg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXOG4lZKwn7B4x3K0DqVaZ0flp15cNCRDD5Cmh2ZTAUDVhGoGSc2L1ZhdpuwiJho9zee8meGxfF_cFIM014HoE_B4fbHiyfk7pvnuwWYH_H-UCtu27X7unoVP4BR_y90ea)

### How to Cope Safely

- **Give it time and rest:** Only time clears alcohol byproducts and restores normal brain and immune activity. Extra sleep helps offset poor sleep quality.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXoCen97wETPJGIy1eD8CAZNeKRt8Ej6Y3dNCgYrIfK_bdO0IeIBenDEfCUif-zCeuLzNhqGzR5EtmHcHy72Jc3g3_hvfL2Gc9vWyoo2XiaOhyL3MVRzPsCwfqvapW1yG3-kfHvvns-w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1xmBQWLPtUTSQ3zVx6cvRaP-fVT9VjZ3Q22oOxDEFxAYVayW1mCIkG5ZJrCDP3eloJ4q2mLrJJxdY8o23XkC_K7z891NF35II-PyjnnJZ2Yu2I5hk6bAbvGn26614yOdvOZhjtYiiP3SGIVyNde0bsqs7DaiJpNSzvIDINWk3QEI)
- **Sip fluids and eat light carbs:** Drink water and eat gentle carbohydrates (like toast or crackers) to help steady your energy and stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXJmqMdj3V3f03soPUR0Hz0h1jjI2cpIFIqqJUolf0KgokCLVQBLznKCZRSFUyWhMiq8aTDfCUiRbvQyLdd0lZSvFe3rjRCHNdC3UuWWdOOLJMTcPyDhze_qSjc2dXsC1TY4BhPogxOr9adR4ocBaGk7_N6g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF12VDyv3MaSXlTPTF_BMwjI36AQYIo-zWKwj2lv6zW1L0WaUu7VJV-dtWHr3-zvzr77C1MOGyAjkloIn7HKufknuL6JSnReDw3wHLGFDpjWOF0vS6bFEO6f3se6x5kLZ3fWkIKRyP_jHCR17zgVzJ3ARxC-UKTTj0r_7zdKdF_kD-8J-6pxp1bWNq3-PP)
- **Be cautious with caffeine and pain relievers:** A modest cup of coffee is generally fine, though heavy caffeine can worsen jitteriness or a racing heart. Avoid acetaminophen (Tylenol) with alcohol due to liver toxicity risk, and use NSAIDs (like ibuprofen) carefully if your stomach is irritated.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF1-YD9u9CvG-sCTtzYg4M8PgQ7zI6rUAQQob20Q-smwJrSMbZ03gfFvkr1i6JMfB-yD49_-Cp_5EY2cmfKAPrA9eyWCMMoSTQzMWnBU7_XeEMjzdJI97R0zWUhsqQXCTbyUpigCRkqPjC30OeqpVCZJMSeqfVZg0t9PBjhJaJ4_zJKj599meVNMIhwJNN1ma_B33GxWv5DGsFOQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1xmBQWLPtUTSQ3zVx6cvRaP-fVT9VjZ3Q22oOxDEFxAYVayW1mCIkG5ZJrCDP3eloJ4q2mLrJJxdY8o23XkC_K7z891NF35II-PyjnnJZ2Yu2I5hk6bAbvGn26614yOdvOZhjtYiiP3SGIVyNde0bsqs7DaiJpNSzvIDINWk3QEI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXoCen97wETPJGIy1eD8CAZNeKRt8Ej6Y3dNCgYrIfK_bdO0IeIBenDEfCUif-zCeuLzNhqGzR5EtmHcHy72Jc3g3_hvfL2Gc9vWyoo2XiaOhyL3MVRzPsCwfqvapW1yG3-kfHvvns-w)

For more details on mechanisms and recovery, see the [National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1xmBQWLPtUTSQ3zVx6cvRaP-fVT9VjZ3Q22oOxDEFxAYVayW1mCIkG5ZJrCDP3eloJ4q2mLrJJxdY8o23XkC_K7z891NF35II-PyjnnJZ2Yu2I5hk6bAbvGn26614yOdvOZhjtYiiP3SGIVyNde0bsqs7DaiJpNSzvIDINWk3QEI) and the [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXJmqMdj3V3f03soPUR0Hz0h1jjI2cpIFIqqJUolf0KgokCLVQBLznKCZRSFUyWhMiq8aTDfCUiRbvQyLdd0lZSvFe3rjRCHNdC3UuWWdOOLJMTcPyDhze_qSjc2dXsC1TY4BhPogxOr9adR4ocBaGk7_N6g).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1xmBQWLPtUTSQ3zVx6cvRaP-fVT9VjZ3Q22oOxDEFxAYVayW1mCIkG5ZJrCDP3eloJ4q2mLrJJxdY8o23XkC_K7z891NF35II-PyjnnJZ2Yu2I5hk6bAbvGn26614yOdvOZhjtYiiP3SGIVyNde0bsqs7DaiJpNSzvIDINWk3QEI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXJmqMdj3V3f03soPUR0Hz0h1jjI2cpIFIqqJUolf0KgokCLVQBLznKCZRSFUyWhMiq8aTDfCUiRbvQyLdd0lZSvFe3rjRCHNdC3UuWWdOOLJMTcPyDhze_qSjc2dXsC1TY4BhPogxOr9adR4ocBaGk7_N6g)Are you asking for **yourself** or **someone else** , and are there **other symptoms** (like nausea, headache, or dizziness) or a **timeline** you want to share?
